contract.S: No new persistence; Host owns current WorkSnapshot, Git owns SourceCut, each natural Owner owns verifier receipts and live evidence; task-local Composition projection is rebuildable
contract.pre: Native Git reporter and CLI recomputation bind exact SourceCut and scoped path members; Owner source readset completeness is caller-declared and NOT certified; old verifier receipt and currentness separate
contract.post: Only impacted obligations become recheck proposals, unindexed/unknown sources become qualification requests, unaffected candidates trigger prior-proof read rather than rerun; Host established/unresolved/referenceRefs unchanged
contract.inv: REUSE_CANDIDATE is never VERIFIED; UNKNOWN is never FALSE; no automatic verifier execution; nextActions are stable under replay; Rust Engagement/terminal Work never receives legacy CAS proposal; Direct Git source route and manual graph route use exactly one C04 selection family and one Agent action renderer; changedRefs report cannot bypass native Git CLI requalification; strict Draft202012 source action output rejects false proofVerifiedByProjection, impossible status/decision combinations and caller-certified Owner closure; Git member-set changes conservatively block unaffected positive-readset proofs as UNKNOWN until negative/glob/dynamic dependency closure is qualified; re-verification request must first qualify a current Work Owner receipt even for changed inputs, without asserting the receipt is valid
contract.eff: None. Read-only analysis and pure optional proposed legacy WorkSnapshot. Any Host CAS, Runtime execution or real Owner proof admission is a separate consumer-authorized effect
contract.c: O(V+E) existing Composition impact fixed-point plus O(Host nextActions); installed Agent latency and tokens UNKNOWN
contract.epsilon: UNKNOWN(reason=owner proof authenticity, dynamic/negative dependency closure, installed currentness and live policy not qualified; obligation=separate native Owner readback before claiming VERIFIED)
